youtube.title: Golf ball pe dimples kyun hote hain? ⛳ #Shorts
youtube.description:
Ek bilkul smooth golf ball lagbhag aadhi door tak hi jaati. Toh phir golf balls pe itne saare dents kyun hote hain? Shuruat mein golf balls smooth hi hoti thi, phir golfers ne ek ajeeb cheez notice ki: purani, ghisi hui balls, jin pe nicks aur scratches the, naye balls se zyada door jaati thi.

Raaz hawa mein hai. Smooth ball udti hai toh hawa uski peeth se jaldi alag ho jaati hai aur peeche ek bada ghumta hua wake chhod deti hai, jo ball ko peeche kheenchta hai. Dimples hawa ki ek patli layer ko ball se zyada der tak chipkaaye rakhte hain, wake chhota ho jaata hai, aur drag bhi kam ho jaata hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
